description: Ground truth for data/ships/pre-engineered.jsonc — the purchasable pre-engineered module variants. A pre-engineered module has no symbol of its own, so each record pairs a base module `symbol` (joins to the module catalogues) with the `blueprint` baked in at purchase and the `grade` already applied. Neither column is unique on its own: one module is sold in several flavours and one blueprint is sold on several modules, so the (symbol, blueprint) pair is the key. `count` pins the catalogue size; `records` pins individual pairings; `multiVariant` pins the several-flavours case; `joins` pins that every record resolves against the module and blueprint catalogues.
